caseData.courtName: SUPERIOR COURT, JUDICIAL DISTRICT OF HARTFORD
caseData.prosecutorPosition: does not object to the motion

chargeData.chargeDescription: Breach of peace in the second degree

additionalFacts: Thirteen months have elapsed since the nolle, so your records were erased on 02/01/2025.
Attached is your Motion to Nolle a Continued Charge for filing in the Superior Court, Judicial District of Hartford.
The State's Attorney was served with the motion and does not object.
The court granted the motion and the charge has been nolled.
A filing fee of $75.00 is payable to the clerk.

expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA for these reasons: (1) it attaches a drafted § 54-142a(c)(2) motion, the exact document held back because its caption, venue, service and clerk practice are unapproved and no form was located; (2) it selects the branch on the participant's behalf — the answer to "was the charge nolled, or is it still being continued" selects the branch and LegalEase does not choose one; (3) it computes the thirteen-month clock and asserts a specific erasure date, which is arithmetic on participant-supplied dates that this route never performs; (4) it fills court name, judicial district, county, docket number, OTN, judge, prosecutor and prosecutor position on a branch that has no filing at all; (5) it asserts an outside-party act and service completion (the State's Attorney was served and does not object) where service is expressly unresolved; (6) it asserts a hearing outcome (the court granted the motion and the charge has been nolled); (7) it states a filing fee when § 54-142a(k) says no court fee is charged in any court for a petition under this section; (8) it uses the prohibited term 'expunged' — Connecticut says erasure; and (9) it populates protected fields that must stay blank.
